name: R. S. Mason
story: R. S. Mason joined PEL’s Remote Sensing Section in 1974. The 1976 programme report records his work preparing aircraft multispectral surveys, constructing electronic equipment and evaluating instruments.
A. D. Fowler was involved in colour processing, multispectral compositing and calibration, while R. S. Mason worked on electronics and preparation of the aircraft multispectral system.
